patterns.note: Vibrant, full-bleed background colors define distinct content sections, creating strong visual breaks and a playful mood.
Oversized, pixelated display headings serve as prominent visual anchors for each section, contrasting with clean sans-serif body text.
The initial hero content scrolls away to reveal a larger, centered product shot that takes over the viewport, creating a focused product reveal.
A subtle pixelated background pattern continuously shifts or parallaxes as the user scrolls, adding dynamic texture.
Content is presented in full-width, full-height sections, each with a distinct background color and a large, centered heading.

technique_notes: Achieve a retro-futuristic pixel art aesthetic by using a custom pixelated font for display text and integrating pixel-grid patterns into backgrounds and graphic elements.
Create distinct full-width sections with vibrant, solid background colors that scroll into view, each introduced by an oversized, pixelated heading.

Implement scroll-triggered animations (using css-keyframes) where initial hero content scrolls out, revealing a larger, focused product image that temporarily takes over the viewport. A sticky call-to-action button persists in the header throughout the scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, pixelated display headings (~4-5x body) with clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on product elements, but overall aesthetic leans sharp/pixelated.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous spacing between full-bleed sections, creating clear visual separation and impact.

standout: The site's distinctive pixel art aesthetic, combined with vibrant, almost neon color blocking and a playful, retro-futuristic product design, creates a unique and memorable brand identity that stands apart from typical modern tech product sites. The oversized, pixelated headings are a strong visual signature.
